summary: DoubleDown Interactive (NASDAQ: DDI) filed Form 6-K confirming receipt of a non-binding expression of interest from controlling shareholder DoubleU Games (DUG), which holds ~67.1% of shares, to acquire all outstanding common shares and ADSs not already held by DUG at $11.25 per ADS in cash. The board formed a special committee of independent directors to evaluate the proposal and will retain legal and financial advisors. The non-binding nature means no deal is assured; watch for special committee negotiation, potential higher bid, and regulatory review by Korean authorities or CFIUS. Risk-arb spread will reflect uncertainty around the ultimate price and close timeline.
